study: Development-only learned selection among fixed plan-assisted Saudi LoRA candidates
candidate_origin: Actual unmodified completions from the controlled local adapter/automatic-plan study. No reference answer, hand edit or case-specific generation rule. These four global configurations are the same for every case.
motivation: No single configuration met 4/4; the preserved pilot and approved v2 have complementary observed development strengths. Candidate coverage and selector accuracy are separate quantities.
selectors: Original Faisal adapter on the pinned local 4-bit Qwen base, scoring next-token option letters
Pinned private Qwen3.6 Q8 greedy endpoint returning a single choice letter
task: Identical decision JSON with original state, fallible automatic meaning plan and anonymous A-D candidate texts. E explicitly rejects all candidates. No model names, assistant labels or correctness scores are supplied to either selector.
order: Shuffle candidate order independently per case with random.Random(20261122), before either selector runs; reject-all remains last.
qualification: Selected candidate must strictly pass all four exposed development cases. Prefer Faisal on a tie for lower compute. NONE, malformed selection or incomplete generation is a failure, not a fallback answer.
further_gates: Qualifying combined system still requires actual bfloat16 full-pipeline development, user UI regressions, the untouched 16-case >=13/16 gate with changed-intent contrasts and <=150 second warm latency. Do not open the fresh test if development fails.
interpretation: System-level candidate selection does not establish that v2 alone is better or that it generalizes independently. Both individual failures and complete-system evidence must remain visible.
reviewer: Assistant only; independent human Saudi Arabic evaluation remains pending
